sentences.en: Sochi has a subtropical climate and temperatures rarely fall below freezing.
sentences.zh: 索契拥有亚热带气候，气温很少降至冰点以下。

sentences.en: The horse latitudes are subtropical regions known for calm winds and little precipitation.
sentences.zh: 马纬度是亚热带地区，以风平浪静和降水稀少著称。

sentences.en: The beaches in the subtropical zone attract many tourists every summer.
sentences.zh: 亚热带地区的海滩每年夏天都会吸引很多游客。

senses.zh: 亚热带的; 亚热带特点的
